content.short: Deploys a full DAO, with token, treasury and governor, in one transaction for gas only.
content.description: CreateDAO turns setting up a DAO into a single call. One transaction deploys an ERC20Votes token, a timelocked treasury and an OpenZeppelin governor, using minimal proxy clones that cut gas costs by around 90%. The creator gets 1% of the supply and the treasury 99%, unlocked only by votes, and holders are delegated automatically so they can vote at once. There are no platform fees.
content.meta: Launch a DAO with token, treasury and governor in one transaction on CreateDAO, with auto-delegation and no platform fee.
